raw_source_description: There are 9 plants and 9 labels. The label generally seems to be at the right of its plant. No label is visible on the container. Joined with f101v1.R2 by J. Stolfi plant <f101v2>[2,1] - one round leaf Between plants <f101v2>[2,1] and <f101v2>[2,2], at top. Grove's X.3.
plant <f101v2>[2,2] - three "serrated spatula" leaves Between plants <f101v2>[2,2] and <f101v2>[2,3], at top. Grove's X.2.
plant <f101v2>[2,3] - serrated fan-like leaf, centipede root Between plants <f101v2>[2,3] and <f101v2>[2,4], at top. Grove's X.5.
plant <f101v2>[2,4] - light star-shaped leaves/flowers, snail-like roots Between plants <f101v2>[2,4] and <f101v2>[2,5], at mid-height, over fold. Grove's X.4. The EVMT version has not been checked.
plant <f101v2>[2,5] - three leaves (two dark around one light) Between plants <f101v2>[2,5] and <f101v2>[2,6], at top.
plant <f101v2>[2,6] - leaves with light lobes, light stem, tiny root Between plants <f101v2>[2,6] and <f101v2>[2,7], at mid-height.
plant <f101v2>[2,7] - two dark paddle-shaped leaves, tiny root Above plant <f101v2>[2,7].
plant <f101v2>[2,8] - single leaf with light teeth, thin horiz root Between plants <f101v2>[2,8] and <f101v2>[2,9], at top.
plant <f101v2>[2,9] - soft leaves, thick horiz root East of plant <f101v2>[2,9], at top.
